reply.emotion: casual and everyday, heading out for the day
notes: In Mexico and many Latin American countries, el carro is the most common word for a private automobile.
Do not confuse it with el coche (also common for car) or la carreta (which is a heavy cart).

senses.definition: Vehículo con cuatro ruedas y un motor que sirve para transportar personas.

examples.text: Dejó su carro estacionado frente a la casa.
examples.translation: He left his car parked in front of the house.

senses.definition: Plataforma con ruedas que se empuja o se jala para llevar carga.

examples.text: Llenó el carro del supermercado con mucha comida.
examples.translation: He filled the supermarket cart with a lot of food.
examples.emotion: busy and purposeful, rushing through chores
